_meta.description: Storage bands per food type, used by edge rules, the simulator and the ML features.
_meta.status: PLACEHOLDER VALUES - TODO-verify every number against the cited reference before any real use.
_meta.reference: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66, 'The Commercial Storage of Fruits, Vegetables, and Florist and Nursery Stocks' (commodity storage tables).
_meta.reference_note: Temperature/RH values below were written from general postharvest knowledge and are NOT yet checked line-by-line against the handbook; no page numbers are claimed.
_meta.nominal_shelf_life_h_note: SIMULATOR ASSUMPTION, not a measured or cited value. It only sets the time scale of the simulated quality model.

mango.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (mango) - chilling-sensitive below ~10 C; mature-green around 13 C

banana.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (banana, green) - chilling injury below ~13 C

tomato.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (tomato, mature-green to ripe) - band simplified to one range

leafy_vegetables.source: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 (leafy greens, e.g. lettuce/spinach) - near 0 C, very high RH

milk.source: General dairy cold-chain practice (chilled milk at or below about 4 C); no citation - TODO-verify against FSSAI / dairy guidance
